name: Svalbard
about: Midnight sun (Apr–Aug) keeps it light around the clock with zero aurora chances; polar night (Nov–Jan) brings roughly 24-hour darkness and the best northern lights viewing.
overview: The world's northernmost year-round settlement — more polar bears than people, glaciers calving into Arctic fjords, and genuine 24-hour daylight or darkness depending on the season.
costOverview: There's no budget tier here — Svalbard is one of the most remote, expensive places on Earth to visit, and virtually every real activity requires a guide, mandatory outside Longyearbyen for polar bear safety.

specialSeasons.text: Midnight sun keeps it light around the clock — no real stargazing or aurora viewing possible.
Polar night brings roughly 24-hour darkness, the best window for the northern lights.
